CALC_FPL_ANNUAL: Federal poverty line for this many people, per year
CALC_FPL_MONTHLY: Federal poverty line for this many people, per month
CALC_LIMIT_PCT_OF_FPL: This program's limit, as a share of the poverty line
CALC_INCOME_PCT_OF_FPL: Your income, as a share of the poverty line
CALC_SNAP_EARNED_INCOME_DEDUCTION: 20% of money you earn from work
CALC_SNAP_DEPENDENT_CARE_DEDUCTION: Child care or adult care costs
CALC_SNAP_MEDICAL_DEDUCTION: Medical costs over $35 (older or disabled members)
CALC_SNAP_MAX_ALLOTMENT: Most SNAP pays for this many people
